rubrics.criterion: Agent enumerates the recurring Gringotts bill_pay entries as they appear live (each payee with its amount and frequency) and reports a monthly subtotal that is arithmetically consistent with the list it reported. The live list includes a monthly credit-card payment line that the app does not flag as autopay; a total that includes it and a total that excludes it are both acceptable so long as the agent states which rows it counted.

Agent accounts for the improv class as a recurring cost using the per-session amount and cadence shown in the Gringotts transactions ledger (a bill_pay improv payee is also acceptable if one is listed live), provided the agent says which source it used and does not count improv twice in the same subtotal.
Agent scans for other recurring charges and reports findings
Agent optionally checks HooliMail for renewal notices covering the recurring subscriptions and any other regular payments; absence of such emails is acceptable since the primary source is Gringotts
Agent reports both monthly and annual combined totals
Quality: Complete rollup is clear and totaled
Agent completes a rollup of everything the user pays regularly including subscriptions, improv class, and any other recurring charges with monthly and annual totals
